title: Schedule of Permit Renewal History Credit for Temporary For-Hire Permits
content:
For **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** agreements, a Wayfare driver's record of for-hire permit uploads bears on the temporary permit acceptance days, the calendar days from the upload day for which a temporary for-hire permit is accepted as the for-hire permit on file.

**Permit renewal history rule.** When the standing record holds three or more for-hire permit uploads dated fewer than 36 whole calendar months before the upload day, the temporary permit acceptance days gain 5 days; when it holds exactly two, they gain 2 days; when it holds one or none, they gain none.

| For-hire permit uploads on the standing record dated fewer than 36 whole calendar months before the upload day | Days gained |
|---|---|
| three or more | 5 |
| exactly two | 2 |
| one | 0 |
| none | 0 |

**Notes to the schedule.**
1. Every for-hire permit upload on the standing record within the window counts; uploads of other documents do not.
2. An upload dated 36 whole calendar months or more before the upload day is outside the window.

**Hypothetical reading.** Upload day 2026-09-05; earlier permit uploads dated 2023-08-30, 2024-09-01 and 2025-09-02. The upload of 2023-08-30 is outside the window; two count, and the permit gains 2 days.
